title: Loop without Exit Loop If
description: Error-prone rule — scripts with a Loop but no reliable terminator: neither an Exit Loop If nor a "Go to Record/Request/Page" or "Go to Portal Row" with "Exit after last" inside the loop. The remaining loops risk running forever.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A loop without an explicit Exit Loop If risks an infinite loop if the implicit exit is missing.
rule.remediation: Confirm a reliable exit condition (Exit Loop If, or Go to Record/Portal Row with "exit after last").
